description: Use a browser runtime to trace preview, embed, and scene URLs for a single viewport, with optional session-aware capture when Playwright is available.

capture_screenshot.description: Take a full-page PNG screenshot (needed for visual verification).

pattern.description: Case-insensitive regex for network/HTML URLs to report as embed or source hits (default spline|preview|embed|viewer|scene|iframe).

storage_state_output_path.description: Path to write the browser storage state after capture, so the session can be reused.

storage_state_path.description: Path to a Playwright storage-state JSON (cookies, localStorage) to load before capture, for pages behind a login the user owns.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to inspect, capture, or clone.

user_data_dir.description: Path to an existing Chrome profile directory, to capture a page behind a login the user owns. Omit for a clean session.

viewport_height.description: Primary browser viewport height in CSS pixels (default 1200).

viewport_width.description: Primary browser viewport width in CSS pixels (default 1440).

wait_seconds.description: Upper bound in seconds for each browser readiness wait (load, network quiet, lazy-load scroll); capture continues as soon as the page settles.

name: trace_runtime_sources
